description: Declare an incident by hand, for a problem no monitor detects. It appears under Incident Management in the dashboard and, with an escalation policy, pages its on-call responders. Internal: nothing is published on a status page (create_status_page_incident does that).

description.description: What is wrong, e.g. "Payments failing at checkout". Shown as the incident title.

escalation_policy_uuid.description: Escalation policy whose on-call responders are paged (list_escalation_policies). Without one, nobody is paged.

severity.description: Severity key: "critical", "major" or "minor" by default. Defaults to the least severe.

name: create_outage
title: Declare an incident
